name: Bhindi Gosht
description: A classic Pakistani curry combining tender beef with bhindi in a rich onion-tomato masala.
method: Lightly fry the bhindi until it loses excess moisture, then set aside.
Cook onions until golden and add ginger-garlic paste.
Add beef, tomatoes and spices and cook until the masala thickens.
Add a little water, cover and cook until the beef is tender.
Fold in the fried bhindi and green chilies and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes.
Serve hot with roti or naan.
